core_obligations: The author thickens the holonomy groupoid of Kuranishi local slices by controlled automorphism directions and verifies the analytic source/target/composition structure. Under the original bounded h0 and regular-atlas assumptions, the constructed groupoids present the Teichmuller stack and its mapping-class extension presents the Riemann moduli stack; all gluing and stackification proofs retained.
